lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately eight vertical columns of 3 to 5 units, extending from the posterior gill region across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a rectilinear pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a horizontal orientation with a sharp vertical pixel gradient (light superiorly, shadow inferiorly).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregular high-luminance patch is visible on the distal leading edge and tip of the right pectoral fin, consistent with physical trauma or a depigmented lesion.
